Name: Amon, King of Judah
Summary: Amon, son of Manasseh, walked in all his father's ways and served the idols his father served, and after two years his servants conspired and slew him.
RelatedPeople: Manasseh, King of Judah; Meshullemeth, Mother of Amon; King Josiah
LifeLesson: Following a father's sins without his repentance is a short road to ruin.
